ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central fields on both lobes. Black pigmentation concentrated at the peduncle junction, trailing edges, and as distinct linear streaks. Two circular black pixel clusters located in the upper distal quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated aperture angle of 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary; extreme topographical variance and protruding clusters at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to tapered, pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular black pixel clusters in the upper left quadrant. Densely packed, high-relief textured clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral field, primarily concentrated on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular protrusions and parasitic/epibiotic crusting at both fluke tips. Extensive linear scarring across the pigmentation field.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique twin-spot circular pigmentation pattern in the upper-left distal region.
